game.romname: Call of Duty - World at War (USA, Europe)
game.name: Call of Duty : World at War (Germany)
game.desc: This fifth main installment of the Call of Duty series returns the setting to World War II. This game is the first title in the Black Ops story line, and it is also the first game in the series to feature the zombies mode. The narrative for the campaign mode focuses on the Pacific and Eastern Front theaters of World War II, involving the United States, Empire of Japan, Soviet Union, and Nazi Germany.
